chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), which is among the things he used to report regarding the great battles at Basra.

key_terms.الْمَلَاحِمِ: The great battles or wars (plural of malḥama)
key_terms.بِالْبَصْرَةِ: In Basra (a major city in Iraq)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the major battles in Basra?
ai.summary: This passage serves as a header for Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) prophetic discourse on al-Malāḥim (the great battles), specifically linking the early civil conflicts in Basra to the broader eschatological narrative of Islamic history. It highlights the scholarly tradition of viewing these historical events not merely as political struggles, but as significant signs (āyāt) fulfilling divine decree, a theme central to Shia historiography.
